column1: # Every printed case total for a country outside the DRC, one row per source
# and as-of date. Hand-authored from data/raw/exports/sources.tsv.
# AN EMPTY CELL IS 'NOT PRINTED', NEVER ZERO. `imported` is the destination's
# own classification; `imported_from_drc` is filled only where the source
# says the import came from the DRC, so a case imported from somewhere the
# source does not name stays visibly apart. `imported_basis` says what the
# imported count is a count OF (confirmed, or confirmed and probable).
# `quote` must appear in the snapshot when `quote_check` is `snapshot`
# (`make check-exports`); `transcribed` quotes are read off scanned images.
